summary: Fintech products for venues and merchants, shipped to web, iOS and Android.
highlights: Led development of the Box Office web panel: ticket and product sales, wallet top-ups, customer management and reporting, used daily by venue staff (React, RTK Query, Zod).
Developed the JoyPort customer wallet app for iOS, Android and web: OTP sign-in, onboarding, QR payments and account management (Expo, NativeWind).
Core developer of the company's React component library; contributed to its React Native counterpart (Radix UI, Tailwind, Storybook).
Delivered the PAX POS device mode with NFC card payments in the merchant terminal app, a customer-facing ticket booking site, and wallet and payment features in the WaaS web app.
